notes.title: New Features & Improvements
notes.content:
New Features & Improvements:

  [list]
[*]   Added a mouse sensitivity slider in the in-game settings for more precise control.
[/list]
   [list]
[*]  Shifted graphics options from the main menu to the in-game pause menu for easier access.
[/list]
  [list]
[*]   When starting a new game, you will now be prompted to enable or disable dialogue voice lines – helpful for non-English speakers or players who prefer subtitles only.
   [/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed NPCs who used to walk in circles. This was originally a joke, but it turns out most of you weren’t fans – so it’s been addressed!
[/list]

notes.title: 🌍 New Update: Localization & Resolution Options!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to share a brand-new update for Once Upon A Mind: A Little Too Friendly — now featuring official localization support and some much-needed performance improvements!

🗣️ Newly Added Languages:
We’ve heard your feedback, and the game is now fully playable in the following additional languages:

    🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese

    🇫🇷 French

    🇩🇪 German

    🇯🇵 Japanese

    🇧🇷 Portuguese (Brazil)

    🇪🇸 Spanish (Spain)

    🇷🇺 Russian


Thank you so much for your continued support and reviews — it means the world to me. If you spot any issues with localization or have feedback, feel free to post in the Community Hub!

Stay safe and enjoy the game in your preferred language! 💬
